candidates.title: Munster’s La Rochelle trip puts the first pre-season marker down
candidates.summary: Munster begin their 2026/27 pre-season away to La Rochelle before a home warm-up against Leicester Tigers.

sourceRecords.title: Munster To Face La Rochelle In Pre-Season
sourceRecords.excerpt: Munster confirmed La Rochelle away on 28 August and Leicester Tigers at home on 18 September as their two pre-season fixtures.

facts: Munster will play La Rochelle at Stade Marcel Deflandre on Friday 28 August 2026 at 7.30pm.
The La Rochelle match is Munster’s first pre-season fixture ahead of the 2026/27 season.
Leicester Tigers will visit Virgin Media Park on Friday 18 September 2026 at 7.15pm for Munster’s second pre-season fixture.
Munster’s previous competitive meeting with La Rochelle was a 25-24 Champions Cup Round of 16 win in April 2025.
Jack Crowley kicked a late drop goal in that 25-24 Munster win.

candidates.title: Connacht’s August 28 trip starts a two-game pre-season build-up
candidates.summary: Connacht have two August and September pre-season fixtures before opening their URC campaign at Dexcom Stadium on 25 September.

sourceRecords.title: Matches | Connacht Rugby
sourceRecords.excerpt: Connacht’s official match list shows pre-season fixtures on 28 August and 5 September, followed by the URC opener on 25 September.

facts: Connacht’s official fixture list shows an away pre-season friendly at Stade de la Rabine on Friday 28 August 2026 at 7.00pm.
Connacht’s second listed pre-season friendly is at Dexcom Stadium on Saturday 5 September 2026 at 5.00pm.
Connacht’s first listed URC fixture is at Dexcom Stadium on Friday 25 September 2026 at 7.45pm.

candidates.title: Ulster’s September friendlies set the runway for the new URC season
candidates.summary: Ulster face Edinburgh away and Ospreys at Affidea Stadium in September before opening their URC campaign at home to Edinburgh.

sourceRecords.title: Ulster Rugby Confirm 2026-27 Pre-Season Fixtures
sourceRecords.excerpt: Ulster confirmed pre-season fixtures away to Edinburgh and at home to Ospreys ahead of the 2026/27 campaign.

facts: Ulster play Edinburgh at Hive Stadium on Friday 4 September 2026 at 7.45pm in a pre-season friendly.
Ulster host Ospreys at Affidea Stadium on Friday 11 September 2026 at 7.45pm in a pre-season friendly.
Ulster open their 2026/27 URC campaign at home to Edinburgh on Friday 25 September 2026 at 7.45pm.

candidates.title: Leinster start the new URC season with back-to-back South African tests
candidates.summary: Leinster’s first two listed URC fixtures are away to the Lions and Sharks before their first home match of the campaign.

sourceRecords.title: 2026/27 BKT URC fixtures confirmed
sourceRecords.excerpt: Leinster confirmed that the 2026/27 URC campaign begins with two away fixtures in South Africa.

facts: Leinster’s first listed 2026/27 URC match is away to the Lions at Ellis Park on Saturday 26 September 2026.
Leinster’s second listed URC fixture is away to the Sharks on Saturday 3 October 2026.
Leinster’s first two URC fixtures of the new season are both in South Africa.

candidates.title: Ireland Women’s WXV autumn begins with USA and Japan on home soil
candidates.summary: Ireland Women host USA and Japan in September before another Japan Test and a two-match WXV series away to South Africa in October.

sourceRecords.title: Ireland Kick Off WXV Global Series On Home Soil
sourceRecords.excerpt: Irish Rugby confirmed home WXV fixtures against USA and Japan, a further Japan Test in Cork and two WXV Tests against South Africa in Cape Town.

facts: Ireland Women host USA at Tallaght Stadium on Sunday 20 September 2026 in the WXV Global Series.
Ireland Women host Japan at Dexcom Stadium on Sunday 27 September 2026 in the WXV Global Series.
Ireland also play Japan at Virgin Media Park on Saturday 3 October 2026 outside the WXV Global Series window.
Ireland then face South Africa at Athlone Stadium in Cape Town on 24 October and 31 October 2026.
